GALLIFORD TRY APPOINTED TO £110 MILLION RIVER MEASE IMPROVEMENT PROJECT

Galliford Try, the UK construction group, announces that its Environment business has been appointed to a £110 million contract to deliver the River Mease Improvement project on behalf of Severn Trent Water.

The project is being driven by Water Industry National Environment Programme (WINEP) requirements and will involve the creation of a 23km cross-country pipeline that conveys flows from the Packington and Measham treatment works.

Bill Hocking, Chief Executive of Galliford Try, commented: "We are delighted to be strengthening our long-standing relationship with Severn Trent with a project of this scale and significance. Delivering the River Mease Improvement project reinforces our position as a leading delivery partner for complex, large-scale water and wastewater infrastructure projects that support environmental compliance and long-term resilience."
Kevin Corbett, General Counsel & Company Secretary

Galliford Try Holdings plc is a leading UK construction group listed on the London Stock Exchange, and a member of the FTSE 250. Operating as Galliford Try and Morrison Construction, the group carries out building and infrastructure projects with clients in the public, private and regulated sectors across the UK.
